 UFC Doha: Prochazka vs. Stirling kicks off the prelims with a late-notice lightweight showdown between Irish UFC debutant John Mitchell and English newcomer Shoaib Yousaf. Check out our UFC Doha odds series for our Mitchell-Yousaf prediction and pick.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement John Mitchell (11-3) gets his long-awaited UFC call-up after returning to the win column in emphatic fashion this summer. The Irishman flattened Kallew dos Santos via first-round TKO in 59 seconds at Cage Conflict 18 in July following a unanimous decision defeat to Makkasharip Zaynukov at PFL Champions Series 2 as he comes into his fight this weekend against Shoaib Yousaf.
 Shoaib Yousaf (14-3) arrives in Doha riding a blistering six-fight winning streak capped by three consecutive first-round knockouts. The former IMMAF world champion stopped Tariel Abbasov via first-round TKO punches at FCC 47 in September after finishing Arley Figueiredo Vaz with a first-round punch in February as he comes into his fight this weekend against John Mitchell.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement UFC Doha Odds: John Mitchell-Shoaib Yousaf Odds 
 John Mitchell: -135
 Shoaib Yousaf: +114
 Over 2.5 rounds: -160
 Under 2.5 rounds: +124
 Why John Mitchell Will Win 
 John Mitchell enters this short-notice debut battle-tested against a far higher caliber of international competition than most UFC newcomers. Competing in PFL Europe finals and PFL Champions Series bouts against killers like Jakub Kaszuba and Makkasharip Zaynukov forged legitimate big-stage composure.
 Even in his October 2025 loss to Zaynukov, Mitchell went all three rounds with a top-75 lightweight, proving his durability and defensive grit hold up against high-level opposition. Fighting out of Pedro Bessa BJJ Cork, Mitchell pairs sturdy grappling fundamentals with heavy hands and physical strength at 155 pounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Crucially, Mitchell is a natural lightweight whereas Shoaib Yousaf spent much of his career competing down at featherweight. That size and physicality edge becomes amplified on short notice, especially when clinches and fence wrestling come into play.
 Mitchell also showed sharp finishing instincts in July by blasting Kallew dos Santos inside a single minute. If Mitchell drags Yousaf into heavy grappling exchanges and leans his natural lightweight frame on him early, he can neutralize Yousaf's speed and take over late.
 Why Shoaib Yousaf Will Win 
 Shoaib Yousaf enters his UFC debut carrying unstoppable momentum, having won six straight fights including three consecutive first-round knockouts across 2025 and 2026. A former IMMAF world champion training out of Predators MMA, Yousaf combines crisp striking instincts with veteran polish across 17 pro bouts.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Yousaf also holds a key recency edge in activity, having fought and finished Tariel Abbasov in late September—meaning he was already in sharp fighting shape when the late UFC call arrived. His blistering hands and explosive knees have repeatedly overwhelmed opponents before they could settle into a grappling rhythm.
 While Mitchell has fought high-level competition, he has been stopped twice in his career—including a second-round TKO loss to Jakub Kaszuba after fading from a hot start. Yousaf, by contrast, has never been finished in 17 professional outings, dropping all three of his career losses by decision.
 Moving up to 155 pounds on short notice frees Yousaf from a grueling featherweight cut, preserving his speed and cardio. If Yousaf keeps this contest at striking range and lets his faster hands fly, he has every chance to spoil Mitchell's debut.
 Click Above to Subscribe Final Mitchell-Yousaf Prediction & Pick 
 John Mitchell is the slight pick because his natural lightweight frame and superior strength of schedule should prove decisive in a late-notice debut. Taking a short-notice call up a weight class is always tricky, and Mitchell's battles against PFL mainstays like Makkasharip Zaynukov and Jakub Kaszuba prepared him well for UFC pressure.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Shoaib Yousaf's six-fight winning streak and iron durability ensure he won't go away quietly, and his faster hands could easily bank early moments. However, Yousaf's recent regional finishes came against lower-tier opposition compared to the killers Mitchell has been testing himself against.
 Because Yousaf has never been finished professionally and both men bring tough regional pedigree, this curtain-jerker has strong potential to reach the judges. Look for Mitchell to survive Yousaf's early blitz, impose his size in the clinch, and grind out a hard-earned decision victory.
 Final John Mitchell-Shoaib Yousaf Prediction & Pick: John Mitchell (-135), OVER 2.5 rounds (-160)
